## What changed

Explain the user or maintainer problem this solves.

## How it was tested

List the commands, devices, Android versions, and manual flows you checked. Say clearly what was not tested.

## Screenshots or recording

Include before and after evidence for visible changes.

## Risk check

- [ ] No new permission, data collection, network request, exported component, or background behavior
- [ ] No credential, signing key, personal usage data, or local configuration is included
- [ ] Tests cover the change or the reason they do not is explained
- [ ] Documentation and asset provenance are updated where needed
- [ ] Native claims were tested on a real Android device, or are marked unverified

If the first item is unchecked, describe the data, privilege, user disclosure, denial behavior, and rollback plan.
